No prior-year balance sheet, so beginning cash is null; ending cash = cash lines of the governmental funds balance sheet (p4), certificates of deposit 39,081 in ending_investments. Business-type: proprietary statement Total column (p7): 2,588,000 + 934,018 - 715,536 = 2,806,482; no transfers. Proprietary cash flows from p8 (no noncapital financing section printed). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4; totals equal the Statement of Net Position governmental column, p1), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1); totals from the p1 Total column. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (pp12-13, one line per department column; the General Fund budget schedule p10 is not recorded to avoid double counting); Street Fund budget schedule (p11; budget transfers in 30,000 with no actual, not recorded).
